tools.name: fuel_prices
tools.description: Today's official petrol and high-speed diesel price per litre from OGRA's daily price sheet, the change since the day before, the breakdown of the price (customs duty, petroleum levy, margins, tax) and the daily history. Source and date included.

tools.name: other_prices
tools.description: Official notified prices: kerosene oil and LPG (OGRA, with the earlier prices), piped gas slabs for homes (OGRA, SNGPL and SSGC) and electricity slabs for homes (NEPRA uniform tariff, with fixed charges). Each carries its source PDF and effective date.

tools.name: market_rates
tools.description: Lahore's official daily retail rates from the Market Committee and PAMRA: vegetables, fruit, and chicken and eggs, per kg (or as stated), first and second grade, with the change since the previous day. Lahore only.
